selection_checklist: Verify exact pin numbering on SOT-23-3 (1=GND, 2=VOUT, 3=VIN) and exposed pad net (None).
Confirm output capacitor ESR stability (ESR window 0.025–15 Ω (p.22)) and DC-bias derated capacitance >= 1 µF.
Check worst-case junction temperature Tj = Ta + (Vin,max - 3.3 V) × Iout × θJA stays >= 15 °C below Tj,max (150 °C).
Validate input transient headroom against Vin,max (13.2 V rec / 15 V abs) and Pin 4 (NC vs BYPASS) PCB net connectivity.
